thread:
Ben (AE): quick heads-up — Renewal for SpectraMedia is hitting EOM. They want a reprice + uplift from 250k to 400k ARR, but legal flagged a commit window change. need deal desk guidance and SE availability for a short POC to validate perf on their longer sequences.
Iris (Solutions Eng): I can run a focused perf POC next week — 3 endpoints, sample traffic, 2 days. will need an env with quantization flags and the customer's sample prompts. can the customer share clip of 1-2 long threads?
Ben (AE): @Iris yes, customer agreed to provide redacted logs today. also asked if we can keep current discount bands — they expect retention pricing not net-new.
Samir K.: do we have precedent for re-baselining a committed contract mid-term? pricing-wise, we usually do a pro-rated commit amendment or an uplight credit. Laura, is an exception required?
Laura M. (Deal Desk): @Samir K. short answer: yes, exception needed for >40% uplift to commit. please file a Deal Desk request with the incremental ARR, requested discount, and term. I can pre-approve a technical review path if SE confirms POC outcomes. include a rollback clause in case latency regresses.
Ben (AE): Proposed: move from 250k -> 400k ARR, 12-month extension at new rate, requested 12% blended discount (current is 18%). customer needs pricing by Thu COB.
Iris (Solutions Eng): For the POC I'll validate 95th pct latency and token cost delta. deliverables: perf runbook, sample results, and config diff. estimate 8h infra + 8h test.
Laura M. (Deal Desk): Ack. For my queue I need: 1) exact new MRR/ARR numbers, 2) requested discount %, 3) any special terms (e.g., termination / rollback), 4) security acceptances. Also flag if this needs executive approval.
Ben (AE): Adding details: new ARR 400000, monthly 33333.33, incremental 150000. requested discount 12% blended. Special term: 30-day rollback if p95 > 600ms on >10% of calls post-deploy. Security questionnaire outstanding but CS says no extra controls required.
DealDeskBot: Request submitted: DD-2026-4729. Current SLA: awaiting Deal Desk review. Estimated response time: 48h.
Samir K.: If DD approves, finance needs to update committed forecast + revenue recognition note. Who will own the amendment? Ben?
Ben (AE): I'll own the amendment draft. Laura, can you put a provisional approve if POC passes and discount <= 12%?
Laura M. (Deal Desk): I can do provisional approval for <=12% contingent on SE sign-off and legal sign-off on rollback clause. Final sign-off after Finance reviews revenue impact.
Iris (Solutions Eng): I'll start POC as soon as redacted logs arrive. Can the customer open a temporary VPC endpoint and allow our test account? need IAM details.
Ben (AE): I'll coordinate with customer for VPC access and share logs. Also looping in Legal for the rollback language. Thanks team — trying to get this to the customer by Thu. :pray:
Laura M. (Deal Desk): Noted. I'll queue DD-2026-4729 as high priority and ping finance for forecasting notes.
DealDeskBot: DD-2026-4729 status update: Under review by Deal Desk (priority: high). Expected completion: 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC.
Ben (AE): perfect. I'll update the customer and schedule the POC kickoff for Mon.
Iris (Solutions Eng): got it. will prepare test plan and share by EOD tomorrow.
Ben (AE): thanks everyone :thumbsup:
